findings.message: 'Most printings keep the serpent' / 'अधिकतर मुद्रित पाठ सर्प को ही रखते हैं' generalises beyond the cited evidence. The a3 citations show three texts with śeṣa-pāśa…maṇḍalaṃ (gitapress-shiv-stotra-ratnakar.md, ramakrishna-math-mantrapushpam.md, and the main text of sanskritdocuments-kaalabhairava.md) and two with keśa-pāśa…nirmalaṃ (vanivilas-1910-works-18.md, sanskritdocuments-shivarahasya-kalabhairava.md). Three of five texts does not show that 'most printings' have the serpent. No excerpt makes a claim about printings in general. This is a borderline case of a claim stronger than its source, so a human should decide.
findings.suggested_fix: Soften the wording to something the excerpts support, e.g. en: 'Other printings keep the serpent: …' / hi: 'अन्य मुद्रित पाठ सर्प को ही रखते हैं: …'.
